name: stagger-list
title: Stagger list
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Rows enter and leave in sequence, with a cap on the total delay.

meta.descriptionEs: Las filas entran y salen en secuencia, con un tope al retraso total.

examples.title: Lista escalonada
examples.description: Las filas entran y salen en secuencia, con un tope al retraso total.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320 px, vacío, una fila, cuarenta y RTL.

api.name: items
api.description: Stable ids drive enter and exit.

api.name: children
api.description: Renders one row. The list does not style the content.

api.name: stagger
api.description: Seconds between neighbors before the cap.

api.name: maxStagger
api.description: Longest delay any row may wait. Default 0.4s.

api.name: pending
api.description: Sets aria-busy while a load is in flight.

api.name: className / itemClassName
api.description: Classes for the list and each row.

docs: Clean-room. Staggered enter and exit follow a public description of Jakub Antalik's Transitions UI (https://x.com/jakubantalik/status/2115844862012768541). That product is not open source; no source, sample data, icons, or assets were copied. See docs/layout-transitions.md and NOTICE. Motion is transform and opacity only. The last row never waits longer than maxStagger. Travel is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
